systems.owner: ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Décentralisation, through Prodigy
systems.tiers: national operation launched 27 January 2026, opened in the district of Mahajanga I in early April 2026 and to reach all districts; collects fingerprints, iris and face to issue a unique identifier (NUI) to more than twelve million citizens over 18

note: Identity enrolment only; no civil registration system is described.
